hh_ethnologue_comment.comment: E17/E18/E19/E20/E21/E22/E23/E24/E25/E26/E27/E28/E29 has a separate entry for Yabula Yabula [yxy], but this language was close enough linguistically to count as a variety of Yorta Yorta [xyy] (**hh:g:BoweMorey:YortaYorta**). See also: Yorta Yorta [xyy].
